headline: Rooftop solar presentation by Revision Energy and ideas for the mayor's 2027 priorities.
summary: Revision Energy's John Dunster will talk about rooftop solar. The discussion will then cover which items to bring to the mayor to help set priorities for 2027.
items: Guest John Dunster of Revision Energy on rooftop solar

Updates: no meeting December 21; next meeting January 4, 2027
